en.headline: Customs seizes suspected infringing jewellery worth HK$160,000 at Wan Chai fair
en.dek: Officers arrested a man and a woman after finding about 27 items at a booth of the Jewellery & Gem World Hong Kong September exhibition and a related company in Hung Hom.
body: Hong Kong Customs conducted an enforcement operation on Sunday at the Jewellery & Gem World Hong Kong September exhibition at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre, seizing about 27 items of suspected infringing jewellery with an estimated market value of about HK$160,000.

Customs said it had received information that infringing jewellery was being displayed for sale at some booths during the five-day fair that began on 16 September. After investigation and with the assistance of the copyright owner, officers seized 24 items from one booth and a further three items during a premises search at an associated company in Hung Hom.

A man and a woman aged between 47 and 65 were arrested on suspicion of contravening the Copyright Ordinance. One is the person-in-charge of the company and the other a staff member. Customs said the items, which included earrings, bracelets and necklaces, closely resembled genuine products but were priced at roughly one-fifth of the authentic retail value. An investigation continues and further arrests are not ruled out.
Customs stated that it attaches great importance to combating counterfeiting and infringing activities and deploys officers to exhibitions from time to time for inspections.

zh.headline: 海關會展檢獲約16萬元懷疑侵權首飾 拘兩男女
zh.dek: 關員於灣仔會展「九月香港珠寶首飾展覽會」攤位及紅磡相關公司檢獲約27件懷疑侵權首飾，包括耳環、手鐲及頸鏈。
body: 香港海關周日在灣仔香港會議展覽中心舉行的「九月香港珠寶首飾展覽會」採取執法行動，檢獲約27件懷疑侵權首飾，估計市值約16萬元。
海關早前接獲舉報，指展覽期間有攤位涉嫌售賣侵權首飾。經調查及版權持有人協助後，關員在一個攤位檢獲24件懷疑侵權首飾，其後再到紅磡一間相關貿易公司搜查，再檢獲3件。
行動中拘捕一男一女，年齡介乎47至65歲，分別為公司負責人及職員，涉嫌違反《版權條例》。海關指檢獲的首飾包括耳環、手鐲及頸鏈，仿真度相當高，但售價僅約正貨兩成左右。案件仍在調查，不排除有更多人被捕。
海關強調十分重視打擊侵權活動，並會不時派員到不同展覽會巡查。
